column1: # Renames decided 2026-10-07 (Peter), for ontodag ROLES.md §9 step 7; NOT yet applied to any pack build.
# US spelling in names (ROLES.md §8). A rename never travels by merge, so all of these ship in one core/pack version.
# kind: respell = same concept, new spelling; pair = spelling was the only thing separating two senses; merge = a duplicate joins an existing name;
#       sense = an existing name changes sense; drop = a concept leaves.

column5: core already spells the tool ax
duplicate of core's hard-disk; the merge gives the intended hard-disk ⊑ magnetic-disk
center is a building for an activity
draft is a version of a text
program is a printed event program; software is computer-program
judgment is the act of judging
the advanced-state sense (a value judgment, no children) leaves; the name passes to the next row
civilization now names a particular society at a time and place (the Romans, the Maya)
the walking surface of a room; floor passes to the next row
floor now names a level of a building (children basement, loft); story stays free and means a tale
